rationale.approved: 2026-11-07 direct user adoption: arbitr=任ᴬᴿ, eklektik=折中, kalejdoskop=万花镜. arbitr shares 任 with ajn and kapric for choice depending on will or whim; arbitraci remains 裁ᴬ. eklektik uses the established alternative 折中 and shared 中 for eclectic selection; existing annotations remain unchanged. kalejdoskop keeps 万花 and replaces the tube clue 筒 with the optical mirror clue 镜; the user accepts this comparison including the 4-stroke increase and the established Chinese name 万花筒 remains in annotations. Original identifier algorithm yields arbitr id ar (ᴬᴿ); no other identifier or key ownership changes. Body strokes 16/17/22 to 6/11/26, total 55 to 43. Exclusive 擅,衷,筒 removed, no new characters. Preserve all root decomposition, detailed glosses, short JA/ZH/KO annotations, F/band and fixed legacy. Current and fixed original legacy only; no new intermediate edition or old-spelling aliases.

migration_notice: Only current arbitr, eklektik and kalejdoskop change. Other owners and fixed legacy assignments stay unchanged. No old-spelling aliases or intermediate editions.
